preconditions.description: The number of mountains n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h[i] <= 10**12 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each height h_i must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 1,000,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(h[i] < h[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The heights must be strictly increasing.

postconditions.expression: all(h[i] + 2 > h[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: After the landslide, no two adjacent heights can differ by 2 or more.
The total height of the mountains remains constant after the landslide.
